comment: Accumulated UBS finding fingerprints. A finding counts as KNOWN once it appears here, so 'new' means 'never seen before' rather than 'absent from the last run'. Fingerprints are rule+file+normalized code, never line numbers, so this survives reformatting and rebases. Delete an entry to make that finding new again -- that is the accept-a-known-finding action, and it is deliberately manual.
